  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Las Vegas; Spanish 'las vegas' = the meadows; vega from Iberian/Romance *vāica, cognate with Basque ibai (river) and Latin vāgīna (sheath, scabbard)",
    "reading": "The fertile watered plain, a sheath of green in the desert",
    "languages": ["es", "la", "eu"],
    "source": "Diccionario de la lengua española (RAE), s.v. vega",
    "confidence": 0.9
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Las + Vegas; 'las' (Fr. las = weary) + 'vegas' (Fr. vagues = waves, or vegas as 'vague' = hollow); las vagues = the tired waves",
    "reading": "Weary waves that lap against a hollow, a mirage of rest",
    "languages": ["fr", "es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Las Vegas ~ 'la svegli' (Italian svegli = awaken, imperative) ~ 'l'asvegas' (Greek asphēgos = unshaded, exposed)",
    "reading": "Awaken to the unshaded glare, a call to vigilance in the open",
    "languages": ["it", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Las Vegas → 'gale svas' (Old Norse gale = chant, svas = kin) → 'vase glas' (Dutch vase, glass)",
    "reading": "A glass vessel for chanting kin, a fragile echo of lineage",
    "languages": ["non", "nl"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "L.V. → Latin 'locus veritatis' (place of truth) or 'lumen vitae' (light of life); also 'levis vanitas' (light vanity)",
    "reading": "A place of truth that is but light vanity, a shimmering lie",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "L = 50 (Roman), V = 5, S = 7 (Hebrew shin, fire) → 50 + 5 + 7 = 62; 62 = 'sine' (without) + 'duo' (two) in Latin",
    "reading": "Fifty and five and fire, without duality — a singular blaze",
    "languages": ["la", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Las Vegas: L=30, A=1, S=19, V=22, E=5, G=7, A=1, S=19 (A1Z26) → sum = 104; 104 = 8×13, 8 = infinity, 13 = death/rebirth",
    "reading": "Infinity times death, a cycle of endless renewal in the dust",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Vegas from Latin 'vāgīna' (sheath, scabbard); also 'vāgīre' (to cry, wail) — the meadow as a sheath that cries",
    "reading": "The scabbard that wails, a hollow that emits sound",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "Lewis & Short, Latin Dictionary, s.v. vāgīna",
    "confidence": 0.6
  }
]
